functions.name: create-time-entry

isBillable.description: Whether this work should be billable; explicit to avoid accidental billing policy.

description.description: Ordinary Unicode work description; omitted leaves the provider default, empty explicitly records empty text.

taskId.description: Task associated with the entry, when returned.

personId.description: Person to whom the work is attributed.

limit.description: Maximum results requested for this page; provider rejects values above 500.

query.description: Ordinary Unicode search text; Teamwork determines matching semantics.

types.description: Resource types to search; omitted searches all provider-supported types.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same query, filters, order and limit.

orderBy.description: Provider result ordering, by relevance or date.

projectId.description: Restrict search to one accessible project.

updatedAfter.description: Only items updated after this explicit-offset instant; omitted uses Teamwork's default recent window unless extended search changes it.

includeCompleted.description: Include completed tasks, task lists and milestones.

includeHighlights.description: Request highlighted match fragments where standard search supports them.

includeOlderItems.description: Use extended search to look for items updated more than five years ago; highlights are unavailable there.

includeTentativeProjects.description: Request tentative-project inclusion using Teamwork's corresponding flag.

FunctionInput_teamwork_searchitems.description: Text search and optional resource, lifecycle, date and page controls.

id.description: Matched resource identifier; meaningful together with type.

name.description: Human-facing name, title or summary of the matched item, when supplied.

type.description: Authoritative provider relationship type identifying the resource kind.

minutes.description: Whole-minute duration for time-entry matches, when available.

personId.description: Attributed person identifier for time-entry matches, when available.

updatedAt.description: Matched item's modification instant in UTC, when available and semantically established.

highlights.description: Provider highlighted fragments keyed by field name; markup is preserved and not safe to render without sanitization. Omitted when unavailable.

items.description: Provider match fragment with original Unicode and markup.

tasklistId.description: Associated task-list identifier for task matches, when available.

description.description: Available description or comment title; returned as text, without inventing full content.

items.description: One matched resource, resolved from its typed sideload when available.
Search matches in provider order, with useful summary values resolved from sideloads.

nextCursor.description: Provider continuation wrapped as an opaque token; omitted at exhaustion.

FunctionOutput_teamwork_searchitems.description: One permission-scoped search page and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this for cross-resource text discovery, including task-list IDs needed by `create-task`. Use resource-specific list/get tools for structured browsing or known IDs. Default search covers the provider's recent five-year window; includeOlderItems requests extended search. Continue with nextCursor and unchanged query, filters, ordering and limit. Limit is 1–500, default 50.

functions.name: update-task
functions.description: Partially modify an existing task's text, dates, assignments, tags, privacy, custom fields, recurrence, attachment associations, and workflow placement.

tagIds.description: Complete replacement tag association set; empty array removes all tags.

dueDate.description: Replacement calendar due date; null clears it.

progress.description: Replacement progress percentage; does not by itself promise lifecycle completion.

workflow.description: Place this task in an existing workflow stage; does not change its task list.

stageId.description: Destination stage identifier; 0 represents backlog where supported.

positionAfterTaskId.description: Existing task after which to position this task in the stage; omitted uses provider positioning.

assignees.description: Replace only supplied assignment groups; empty arrays clear their group.

teamIds.description: Replacement team IDs for this group; [] clears it.

personIds.description: Replacement person IDs for this group; [] clears it.

companyIds.description: Replacement company IDs for this group; [] clears it.

jobRoleIds.description: Replacement job-role IDs for this group; [] clears it.

isPrivate.description: Replacement privacy setting; requires privacy permission.

startDate.description: Replacement calendar start date; null clears it.

description.description: Replacement description; empty string clears it.

customFields.description: Update only supplied custom fields; empty array makes no custom-field changes.

value.description: Replacement typed value; null clears this field, distinct from empty text or list.

countryCode.description: Country metadata when required by the field type.

currencySymbol.description: Currency display metadata when required by the field type.

urlTextToDisplay.description: Replacement URL display text when appropriate.

grantAccessTo.description: Replace only supplied private-access groups; empty arrays clear the group.

teamIds.description: Replacement team IDs for this group; [] clears it.

personIds.description: Replacement person IDs for this group; [] clears it.

companyIds.description: Replacement company IDs for this group; [] clears it.

jobRoleIds.description: Replacement job-role IDs for this group; [] clears it.

recurrenceRule.description: Replacement RFC 5545 RRULE; null removes recurrence, subject to provider sequence-edit semantics.

estimateMinutes.description: Replacement whole-minute effort estimate; zero removes estimated effort.

attachmentFileIds.description: Complete replacement set of existing file associations; empty removes associations, not original file content.

descriptionContentType.description: Content type for the replacement description; omit to preserve the existing type.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields and omitted nested groups preserve their current values.

notifyAssignees.description: Ask Teamwork to notify assignees about this modification.

FunctionInput_teamwork_updatetask.description: Identify an existing task and supply only the properties to modify.

id.description: Modified task identifier, unchanged by this operation.

dueDate.description: Returned due date; omitted if unset.

startDate.description: Returned start date; omitted if unset.

updatedAt.description: Modification instant in UTC, when available.

affectedTaskIds.description: Provider-reported affected task IDs; omitted when not returned, not a fabricated success list.

FunctionOutput_teamwork_updatetask.description: Authoritative modified task summary and any provider-reported affected task identifiers.

tags.instructions: Use a task ID from `get-task` or `list-tasks`. Omitted changes preserve existing values; empty assignment/tag arrays remove those associations. Use `move-task` to relocate a task to another task list, `complete-task` to complete it, or `reopen-task` to reopen it. This can overwrite existing content and remove associations. Check `get-task` after an uncertain write instead of blindly retrying.
